mapper.sql: SELECT acc.investor_type, CASE WHEN acc.age < 30 THEN '20대 이하' WHEN acc.age < 40 THEN '30대' WHEN acc.age < 50 THEN '40대' WHEN acc.age < 60 THEN '50대' ELSE '60대 이상' END AS age_band, COALESCE(i.inflow, 0) AS inflow, COALESCE(d.buy_exec, 0) AS buy_exec, COALESCE(d.sell_exec, 0) AS sell_exec FROM ( SELECT a.account_id, c.investor_type, YEAR(#{asOfDate}) - YEAR(c.birth_date) - CASE WHEN MONTH(#{asOfDate}) * 100 + DAY(#{asOfDate}) < MONTH(c.birth_date) * 100 + DAY(c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.opened_at IS NOT NULL AND a.opened_at < #{clockDate} ) acc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, SUM(final_amount) AS inflow FROM krw_exchange WHERE settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND final_at < #{clockDate} AND final_at >= #{periodFrom} GROUP BY account_id ) i ON i.account_id = acc.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN ABS(amount) - fee_amount ELSE 0 END) AS buy_exec, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'SELL' THEN amount + fee_amount + tax_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sell_exec FROM domestic_order WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} AND processed_at >= #{periodFrom} GROUP BY account_id ) d ON d.account_id = acc.account_id

(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rule_type = 'BASIC_DEDUCTION' THEN rule_value END), 0) AS basic, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rule_type = 'TAX_RATE' THEN rule_value END), 0) AS rate FROM tax_rule WHERE valid_from <= #{asOfDate} AND valid_to >= #{asOfDate})
mapper.select: SELECT t.stage_no AS stageNo, t.stage AS stage, t.n AS customers, ROUND(t.n * 1.0 / NULLIF(LAG(t.n) OVER (ORDER BY t.stage_no), 0), 4) AS convPrev, ROUND(t.n * 1.0 / NULLIF(FIRST_VALUE(t.n) OVER (ORDER BY t.stage_no), 0), 4) AS convTotal FROM ( SELECT m.stage_no, m.stage, CASE m.stage_no WHEN 1 THEN s.n1 WHEN 2 THEN s.n2 WHEN 3 THEN s.n3 WHEN 4 THEN s.n4 WHEN 5 THEN s.n5 ELSE s.n6 END AS n FROM ( SELECT 1 AS stage_no, '웹 가입' AS stage UNION ALL SELECT 2, '마이데이터 동의' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '계좌 신청' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '개설' UNION ALL SELECT 5, '첫 매도' UNION ALL SELECT 6, '첫 국내 매수' ) m CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS n1, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n2, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n3, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.opened_at < #{clockDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n4, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.opened_at < #{clockDate} AND so.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n5, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.opened_at < #{clockDate} AND so.account_id IS NOT NULL AND bo.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n6 FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_consent WHERE consent_type = 'MYDATA_PROVISION' AND agreed AND changed_at < #{clockDate} ) k ON k.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN account a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id AND a.created_at < #{clockDate} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM sell_order WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} ) so ON so.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'BUY' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} ) bo ON bo.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.created_at < #{clockDate} AND c.created_at >= #{periodFrom} ) s ) t ORDER BY t.stage_no

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE opened_at IS NOT NULL AND opened_at < #{clockDate}) AS openedAccounts, (SELECT MIN(opened_at) FROM account WHERE opened_at IS NOT NULL AND opened_at < #{clockDate}) AS firstOpenedAt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(final_amount) FROM krw_exchange WHERE settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND final_at < #{clockDate} AND final_at >= #{periodFrom}), 0) AS inflowTotal, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(amount) - fee_amount) FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'BUY' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} AND processed_at >= #{periodFrom}), 0) AS domesticBuyTotal, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount + fee_amount + tax_amount) FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'SELL' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} AND processed_at >= #{periodFrom}), 0) AS domesticSellTotal

SELECT cls.code AS code, COUNT(*) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN cls.external_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withExternalBuy FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN t.weighted_sell = 0 THEN 'NO_SELL' WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' THEN 'BENEFIT_CANCELED' WHEN t.adjust_ratio = 1 THEN 'NO_IMPACT' WHEN t.adjust_ratio > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL_REDUCED' ELSE 'EXTERNAL_BUY_OFFSET' END AS code, t.weighted_external_amount AS external_amount FROM tax_snapshot t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id ) cls GROUP BY cls.code
SELECT MAX(calculated_at) FROM tax_snapshot

SELECT flow_month AS flowMonth, SUM(foreign_sell_amount) AS foreignSellAmount, SUM(krw_inflow_amount) AS krwInflowAmount, SUM(domestic_buy_amount) AS domesticBuyAmount, SUM(domestic_sell_amount) AS domesticSellAmount, SUM(withdrawal_amount) AS withdrawalAmount, SUM(cash_balance_begin) AS cashBalanceBegin, SUM(cash_balance_end) AS cashBalanceEnd FROM fund_flow_monthly WHERE flow_month < #{monthStart} AND flow_month >= #{fromMonth} AND flow_month <= #{toMonth} GROUP BY flow_month ORDER BY flow_month

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sell_qty * base_price) FROM sell_order WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS foreignSellAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(final_amount) FROM krw_exchange WHERE settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND final_at >= #{monthStart} AND final_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS krwInflowAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(amount)) FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'BUY' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticBuyAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'SELL' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticSellAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(requested_amount) FROM withdrawal WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS withdrawalAmount

SELECT p.age_band AS ageBand, p.investor_type AS investorType, COUNT(*) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.inflow > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accountsWithInflow, SUM(p.inflow) AS inflowTotal, SUM(p.buy_exec) AS buyTotal, SUM(p.sell_exec) AS sellTotal FROM (
) p GROUP BY p.age_band, p.investor_type ORDER BY p.age_band, p.investor_type

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts, COALESCE(SUM(r.general_tax), 0) AS generalTaxTotal, COALESCE(SUM(r.final_tax), 0) AS finalTaxTotal, COALESCE(SUM(r.general_tax - r.final_tax), 0) AS reliefTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.general_tax - r.final_tax > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS accountsWithRelief, COALESCE(SUM(r.net_invest), 0) AS netInvestTotal FROM ( SELECT t.final_tax AS final_tax, ROUND(rule.rate * GREATEST(0, t.original_gain_amount - rule.basic), 2) AS general_tax, COALESCE(d.net_invest, 0) AS net_invest FROM tax_snapshot t CROSS JOIN rule LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN ABS(amount) - fee_amount ELSE -(amount + fee_amount + tax_amount) END) AS net_invest FROM domestic_order WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} GROUP BY account_id ) d ON d.account_id = t.account_id ) r
WHERE r.general_tax - r.final_tax > 0

SELECT b.code AS code, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN adjust_ratio = 0 THEN 'ZERO' WHEN adjust_ratio < 0.25 THEN 'UNDER_25' WHEN adjust_ratio < 0.5 THEN 'UNDER_50' WHEN adjust_ratio < 0.75 THEN 'UNDER_75' WHEN adjust_ratio < 1 THEN 'UNDER_100' ELSE 'FULL' END AS code FROM tax_snapshot WHERE weighted_sell > 0 ) b GROUP BY b.code

SELECT r.relief FROM ( SELECT ROUND(rule.rate * GREATEST(0, t.original_gain_amount - rule.basic), 2) - t.final_tax AS relief FROM tax_snapshot t CROSS JOIN rule ) r WHERE r.relief > 0 ORDER BY r.relief

SELECT k.account_id AS accountId, k.final_amount AS finalAmount, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, k.final_at, COALESCE(ev.event_at, #{clockDate})) AS days, CASE WHEN ev.event_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS event FROM krw_exchange k LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.exchange_id, MIN(a.withdrawal_at) AS event_at FROM withdrawal_allocation a JOIN withdrawal w ON w.withdrawal_id = a.withdrawal_id AND w.status = 'COMPLETED' JOIN left_amount l ON l.left_amount_id = a.left_amount_id WHERE a.type = 'IMMATURE_PRINCIPAL_INCLUDED' AND a.withdrawal_at < #{clockDate} GROUP BY l.exchange_id ) ev ON ev.exchange_id = k.exchange_id WHERE k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at < #{clockDate} AND k.final_at >= #{periodFrom} ORDER BY k.account_id, k.exchange_id
mapper.sql: FROM krw_exchange k LEFT JOIN left_amount la ON la.exchange_id = k.exchange_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = k.account_id WHERE k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at IS NOT NULL AND k.final_at < #{clockDate} AND a.status <> 'CLOSED'
mapper.select:
SELECT YEAR(k.final_at) + 1 AS maturityYear, MONTH(k.final_at) AS maturityMonth, COUNT(*) AS lots, COUNT(DISTINCT k.account_id) AS accounts, COALESCE(SUM(k.final_amount), 0) AS paidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(la.cur_amount, 0) END), 0) AS remainingAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' THEN COALESCE(la.cur_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS canceledRemainingAmount
GROUP BY YEAR(k.final_at) + 1, MONTH(k.final_at) ORDER BY YEAR(k.final_at) + 1, MONTH(k.final_at)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' THEN 0 WHEN k.final_at > #{lockBoundary} THEN COALESCE(la.cur_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lockedAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' THEN NULL WHEN k.final_at > #{lockBoundary} AND la.cur_amount > 0 THEN k.account_id END) AS lockedAccounts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' THEN 0 WHEN k.final_at <= #{lockBoundary} THEN COALESCE(la.cur_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS maturedRemainingAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' THEN COALESCE(la.cur_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS canceledRemainingAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' AND la.cur_amount > 0 THEN k.account_id END) AS canceledAccounts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN la.exchange_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lotsWithoutLeftAmount

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(k.final_amount), 0) FROM krw_exchange k JOIN account a ON a.account_id = k.account_id WHERE k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at IS NOT NULL AND k.final_at < #{clockDate} AND a.status = 'CLOSED'
mapper.sql: FROM withdrawal_allocation wa JOIN withdrawal w ON w.withdrawal_id = wa.withdrawal_id AND w.status = 'COMPLETED' JOIN left_amount la ON la.left_amount_id = wa.left_amount_id JOIN krw_exchange k ON k.exchange_id = la.exchange_id WHERE wa.type = 'IMMATURE_PRINCIPAL_INCLUDED' AND wa.withdrawal_at < #{clockDate} AND k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at IS NOT NULL AND k.final_at < #{clockDate}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k.account_id) FROM krw_exchange k WHERE k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at IS NOT NULL AND k.final_at < #{clockDate}) AS finalizedAccounts, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(k.final_amount) FROM krw_exchange k WHERE k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at IS NOT NULL AND k.final_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS finalizedAmount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k.account_id) ) AS earlyAccounts, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(wa.allocated_amount) ), 0) AS earlyWithdrawnAmount

SELECT t.cause AS cause, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS accounts, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_closure_request c WHERE c.withdrawal_id = w.withdrawal_id AND c.status = 'COMPLETED') THEN 'CLOSURE_FORCED' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS cause, k.account_id AS account_id, wa.allocated_amount AS amount
) t GROUP BY t.cause

SELECT p.name AS name, p.type AS type, p.sector_name AS sectorName, SUM(b.qty * b.avg_purchase_price) AS purchaseCost FROM domestic_stock_balance b JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = b.domestic_product_id WHERE b.qty > 0 AND b.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') GROUP BY p.domestic_product_id, p.name, p.type, p.sector_name

SELECT p.name AS name, p.type AS type, p.sector_name AS sectorName, SUM(b.qty * b.avg_purchase_price) AS purchaseCost FROM domestic_stock_balance b JOIN account a ON a.account_id = b.account_id JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = b.domestic_product_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.status = 'OPENED' AND b.qty > 0 AND b.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') GROUP BY p.domestic_product_id, p.name, p.type, p.sector_name

SELECT p.name AS name, p.type AS type, p.sector_name AS sectorName, SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN ABS(o.amount) - o.fee_amount ELSE -(o.amount + o.fee_amount + o.tax_amount) END) AS netBuyExec FROM domestic_order o JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id WHERE o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate} AND o.processed_at >= #{periodFrom} GROUP BY p.domestic_product_id, p.name, p.type, p.sector_name ORDER BY netBuyExec DESC, p.domestic_product_id LIMIT 10

SELECT TRUE AS hasAccount, a.amount AS cashBalance, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.sell_qty * s.base_price) FROM sell_order s WHERE s.account_id = a.account_id AND s.status = 'EXECUTED' AND s.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS soldForeignAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(k.final_amount) FROM krw_exchange k WHERE k.account_id = a.account_id AND k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS krwInflowAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(o.amount) - o.fee_amount) FROM domestic_order o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.side = 'BUY' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticBuyAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.fee_amount) FROM domestic_order o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.side = 'BUY' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticBuyFeeAmount FROM account a WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT f.flow_month AS flowMonth, f.foreign_sell_amount AS foreignSellAmount, f.krw_inflow_amount AS krwInflowAmount, f.domestic_buy_amount AS domesticBuyAmount, f.domestic_sell_amount AS domesticSellAmount, f.withdrawal_amount AS withdrawalAmount, f.cash_balance_begin AS cashBalanceBegin, f.cash_balance_end AS cashBalanceEnd FROM fund_flow_monthly f JOIN account a ON a.account_id = f.account_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND f.flow_month < #{monthStart} ORDER BY f.flow_month

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.sell_qty * s.base_price) FROM sell_order s WHERE s.account_id = a.account_id AND s.status = 'EXECUTED' AND s.processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND s.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS foreignSellAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(k.final_amount) FROM krw_exchange k WHERE k.account_id = a.account_id AND k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at >= #{monthStart} AND k.final_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS krwInflowAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(o.amount)) FROM domestic_order o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.side = 'BUY' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticBuyAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM domestic_order o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.side = 'SELL' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticSellAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(w.requested_amount) FROM withdrawal w WHERE w.account_id = a.account_id AND w.status = 'COMPLETED' AND w.processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND w.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS withdrawalAmount FROM account a WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account a WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL )

SELECT DATE(k.final_at) AS eventDate, 'KRW_CONFIRMED' AS type, NULL AS domesticProductId, NULL AS productName, NULL AS qty, NULL AS price, k.final_amount AS amount, 0 AS feeAmount, 0 AS taxAmount, k.final_amount AS cashAmount, k.final_at AS eventAt FROM krw_exchange k JOIN account a ON a.account_id = k.account_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL AND k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at < #{clockDate} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(o.processed_at), CASE o.side WHEN 'BUY' THEN 'DOMESTIC_BUY' ELSE 'DOMESTIC_SELL' END, o.domestic_product_id, p.name, o.qty, o.price, CASE o.side WHEN 'BUY' THEN ABS(o.amount) - o.fee_amount ELSE o.amount + o.fee_amount + o.tax_amount END, o.fee_amount, o.tax_amount, CASE o.side WHEN 'BUY' THEN -ABS(o.amount) ELSE o.amount END, o.processed_at FROM domestic_order o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(w.processed_at), 'WITHDRAWAL', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, w.requested_amount, 0, 0, -w.requested_amount, w.processed_at FROM withdrawal w JOIN account a ON a.account_id = w.account_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL AND w.status = 'COMPLETED' AND w.processed_at < #{clockDate}

SELECT k.exchange_id AS exchangeId, k.final_at AS finalAt, k.final_amount AS paidAmount, la.cur_amount AS remainingAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(wa.allocated_amount) FROM withdrawal_allocation wa WHERE wa.left_amount_id = la.left_amount_id), 0) AS withdrawnAmount FROM krw_exchange k JOIN account a ON a.account_id = k.account_id JOIN left_amount la ON la.exchange_id = k.exchange_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL AND k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY k.final_at ASC, k.exchange_id ASC

SELECT TRUE AS hasAccount, a.benefit AS benefit, t.weighted_sell AS weightedSell, t.adjust_ratio AS adjustRatio, t.final_deduction AS finalDeduction, t.final_tax AS finalTax, t.calculated_at AS calculatedAt, ROUND(rule.rate * GREATEST(0, t.original_gain_amount - rule.basic), 2) AS generalTax FROM account a LEFT JOIN tax_snapshot t ON t.account_id = a.account_id CROSS JOIN rule WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL
